description: A wallet's trading P&L across venues: Hyperliquid (P&L, volume and return for day, week, month and all time, account value, open perp positions with notional, unrealized P&L and margin use) and Polymarket (P&L, volume and leaderboard rank per window, open positions' value, name and X handle), plus the combined P&L per window. Takes a signer wallet or a Polymarket proxy wallet. From the venues' public APIs. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
name: wallet_trader_pnl
